summary: Campus slip-road loop under tree canopy, signed taxi zone and passenger loading only.
reasons: No Stopping Any Time sign on the loop

best_section.where: north edge of the Chancellors Place slip-road loop beside the library

drivers.seclusion: Campus buildings only, no dwellings mapped; the loop is a pick-up point open to foot traffic.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow looped slip road with tree canopy and footpath at the edge; no room to stop clear of the lane.
drivers.traffic: Taxi and drop-off traffic circulates the loop.
drivers.convention: Taxi Zone, passenger loading limited to 2 minutes, and a No Stopping sign; nobody parks here.
